page_annotations: This verso carries notes keyed to entries on facing fol. 218. Arrows run toward the gutter.
Faint mirrored writing in the lower half is show-through from the reverse of the leaf and is not transcribed.
Small dots and specks are not text.
The facing-page strip at the right (ticks, 'd.', 'e.', 'f.', 'See s.', arrows) is context only.
unresolved_relationships: The links of r002, r003, r005 and r008 to specific fol. 218 entries are probable only.

coverage.finding: The pencil page number '217' with superscript 'b' is visible at top left. The transcription is adequate.
The small ink interlinear '(dated S. 1813?)' sits above 'f. 26, of'. The word 'dated' and the digits are cramped. The uncertainty is correctly kept.
The ink line matches. The title word after 'of' is ambiguous between 'Jaiika-' and 'Jaimika-'. The candidate's '[J?]ai[?]ikasūtras' keeps that open. A tilde-like mark under '26' is noted.

The circled pencil 'alaṃkāra' with '?' is correct. The arrow right of the oval has its head on the LEFT, pointing back toward the oval and away from the gutter. The candidate's 'points toward the gutter' is corrected below. A second arrow '→' with a small mark lies on the facing-page strip at fol. 218 d. 261 (1).
The circled 'Rasāmṛta' above the right part of b006 is correct. Its attachment remains uncertain.

Both pencil lines are represented. The arrow at the right end is '←' with its head toward the text, not toward the gutter. Several incipit readings remain uncertain, e.g. 'kāsya'/'kāśya' and '[s?]naśāno'.
Two letters with dots below and a long slash. The reading is kept uncertain.

'Same as I.O. 38?1' with an altered or barred third digit. The long slash crossing the end is a stroke mark like those in the slashed-letter series. It is better recorded as an annotation than as a literal character.
'ū/'. A tiny dash just above the slash is probably part of the stroke or a speck.
A barred letter with a hook below. The form is uncertain.
